method.how_this_was_produced: Reasoned from the frozen bridge element definitions while reading the verified B-01 bytes. Each element's declared predicate was applied by hand to the fixture's fields.
method.why_not: An expectation obtained by running the bridge and recording the output is a measurement wearing a prediction's clothes. The evidential value of a committed expectation is that it was written before the answer was known, and running first would destroy exactly that.
method.if_execution_disagrees: The disagreement is the finding. This artifact is NOT to be edited to match the observed result; a successor record states both.

what_the_case_actually_does.delta_from_C_00: exactly one field: options.expectedOperationId, operation:plant-7:001 -> operation:plant-7:002
what_the_case_actually_does.everything_else_identical: predicted_effects, both observations and their Ed25519 signatures, source registry, source requirements, observation windows, now, expectedReceiptId, expectedReceiptDigest, expectedActionHash, expectedConsumptionNonce, expectedActionCaid and expectedFacilityId are byte-identical to C-00
what_the_case_actually_does.why_this_is_sharper_than_H_01_b: H-01-b rebound three fields at once — action hash, CAID and operation id — so a bridge could catch it on any one of them. B-01 rebinds ONLY the operation identifier and leaves the action digest and the CAID matching. A bridge that established instance identity from the CAID, or from the action hash, would accept this case. It is caught only by requiring the whole Section 6 conjunction. The contributor picked the narrower attack, and it tests something the open set could not.

expected_claim_support_or_refusal.basis: The observation base cannot be supported because no observation is bound to the asserted action instance, and the IV qualifier cannot be evaluated because no accepted independent-observer observation exists to establish distinctness against.

expected_case_level_verdict.vocabulary_source: the frozen experiment policy; no token added
expected_case_level_verdict.why_indeterminate_and_not_unsupported: The AppraisalInput assembles — evaluation context, boundary finding and counter-evidence are all constructible — so the outcome is not NON_CONSTRUCTIBLE. Both relying-party source requirements are unmet and both prediction groups lack an accepted observation, which is the indeterminate branch rather than a decided refusal on the merits.

I-01.why: Evidence attesting operation:plant-7:001 is not usable as evidence for operation:plant-7:002. Equality of action type, action digest and CAID is insufficient, and the bridge refuses on the operation identifier.

I-03a.why: The provenance binding needed to attribute these observations to the asserted action instance is absent, and the bridge fails closed rather than supplying it by inference.

expected_attacked_invariant_behaviour.comparison_policy_criterion: claim refused and refusal is attributable to instance binding or the CAID premise — satisfied by the reason exact_binding_mismatch:operation_id

reasoned_consequence_for_h_min.claim: NOT PART OF THIS EXPECTATION'S VERDICT — recorded because it follows from the same reasoning and should be on the record before execution rather than after.
reasoned_consequence_for_h_min.open_surface_state: BE-04 and BE-06 masked each other on H-01-b, because that case mutated fields covered by both. Each was therefore NOT_ESTABLISHED individually.
reasoned_consequence_for_h_min.expected_effect_of_B_01: B-01 does not fire BE-06 at all, because the CAID matches. If BE-04 alone were removed, nothing else in the bridge would refuse this case. That would make BE-04 individually necessary against the complete frozen case set.
reasoned_consequence_for_h_min.expected_h_min_movement: 14/17 SUPPORTED could become 15/17, with BE-03 and BE-06 still NOT_ESTABLISHED.
reasoned_consequence_for_h_min.not_a_verdict: Local Minimality remains NOT_EVALUATED until the frozen ablation set is actually run under a separate EXECUTION GO.

chronology.committed_before: any implementation execution, and before the EMILIA-side expectation is requested or seen

non_claims: This is an expectation, not a result. It predicts what the frozen bridge will do; it does not establish it.
It says nothing about whether EMILIA's own native result agrees, and nothing about what EMILIA should conclude.
It is not an execution authorization and confers none.
Being right would not validate the bridge, and being wrong would not invalidate the experiment. Either way the record states both.
